content: Why did the meeting with howie get moved forwards to only one day after dried in milestone? any clue? answer short

Per commit `ad3d44c`: "Meeting moved to one day past dried in because howie was al…" (truncated). Howie was "already" available/on-site sooner than the original 5-day lag anticipated — so the PM tightened FS lag 5d → 1d to catch him right at dry-in rather than waiting a working week.
Can you see the fully untruncated version? howie was already what

No — the commit-message text I can see is truncated at the same "howie was al…" point in every source available to me (only the git status snapshot loaded at session start; I'm read-only and have no shell access to run `git show ad3d44c` for the full body). The task_graph.json entry at `pm.meet_howie_dried_in` still carries the original 5-day reasoning and wasn't updated with the "why," so the untruncated sentence lives only in that commit body. My earlier "already available/on-site" was inference, not quoted fact.
